item.title: State of local emergency declared in Carlsbad due to water main break
item.description: The City of Carlsbad has declared a local state of emergency due to a water main break at a busy intersection, prompting emergency road repairs and a 36-hour timeline for completion.

item.title: Good Samaritans help rescue surfer battered by waves at Sunset Cliffs
item.description: A surfer was rescued after being swept off the rocks by powerful waves at Sunset Cliffs, with the help of two Good Samaritans and San Diego Fire-Rescue, and was taken to a local hospital with non-life-threatening injuries.

item.title: Man arrested on suspicion of assault after targeting women hikers in Carlsbad
item.description: A 22-year-old man has been arrested on suspicion of assaulting several women hikers at the Calavera Nature Preserve in Carlsbad, after being identified by a victim and taken into custody by police.

item.title: Are there groundhogs in San Diego?
item.description: San Diego's mild winter climate and coastal terrain makes it unlikely to see groundhogs, but there are other animals in the area that can be mistaken for them, such as California ground squirrels, pocket gophers, and moles.

item.title: Valley Center man killed in early-morning rollover crash in Escondido
item.description: A 22-year-old man from Valley Center was killed in a solo-vehicle crash in Escondido early Sunday morning after losing control of his vehicle and striking a tree.

item.title: Flying without a Real ID could cost travelers $45 starting February
item.description: Travelers without a Real ID in the U.S. will have to pay an extra $45 fee starting February 1, which can be waived by using the ConfirmID identity verification process.

item.title: VIDEO: Man breaks into iconic PB ice cream shop to satisfy sweet tooth
item.description: A man was caught on surveillance video breaking into Mr. Frostie, an iconic Pacific Beach ice cream shop, in an attempt to satisfy his late-night sweet tooth.

item.title: SR-94 closed in both directions due to multi-vehicle crash at Tecate Rd.
item.description: POTRERO, Calif. (FOX 5/KUSI) -- Cal Fire has confirmed a multi-vehicle crash on Sunday evening shut down SR-94 in both directions at Tecate Rd. item.title: Superbloom outlook: Will San Diego County’s deserts explode in color this spring?
item.description: Anza-Borrego Desert State Park is seeing an early bloom of wildflowers, with many San Diegans wondering if it will turn into a superbloom, though experts caution that a heatwave could "doom the bloom".
